title: Bramley: plague spreaders are the Sumerian overlord faction

tellings.quote: He thinks that basically these uh you know uh plague promulgators >> Mhm. are um representing the same faction that was lording over humanity in the Sumerian epoch

plain: The writer William Bramley, in his book The Gods of Eden, is said to argue that whoever spread the great plagues through Europe belonged to the same group that ruled over humanity in ancient Sumer, the early civilisation of what is now Iraq. The philosopher Jason Jorjani sums up Bramley's idea, without quoting the book directly. If true, it would mean one hidden faction has steered human history from its earliest cities onward.
